moments.why: a single white line from the dark behind the press to the press in an empty black hall: the first thing anyone sees, and it is almost nothing

moments.title: Still smoking
moments.units: 4 PL5403 inside the press and the machine line (ember 5-12 %, breathing 10 s), the mid smoke machine's slow low bursts drifting through them, the far wall ember 15 %
moments.when: act 1 under the one line; act 4 under ash falling
moments.why: the machines glow from inside as if the fire never went out: the hall is alive before anything is lit

moments.title: Columns of fire
moments.units: 6 UP-B380F standing in the far nave (x +-10; z -14, -30, -46), ember from the colour wheel, fanning +-8 deg over 16 bars; 8 PARs on the far nave columns at 30 %, 15 PARs on the side spans' wall columns at 15 % (deep ember)
moments.when: act 2 from the first build; act 3 under the peak
moments.why: 50 m of ruin behind the DJ suddenly has height: the audience looks through him into a burning hall

moments.title: The black
moments.when: before every drop where the fire returns, and before the roof
moments.why: the lasers are 100s of cd/m2 against a dark club's 0.01: the contrast is the epic. Darkness is a cue, written, not an accident

moments.title: The fire returns
moments.units: all 6 laser lines + the fan of 7 and the spine (ash) + the 6 columns of fire (ember) + 4 blinders at <= 40 % (1-2 s hits) + 4 strobes up into the far roof (<= 4 Hz): the only 3-layer moment
moments.when: act 3 only, on the drop, 16 bars, at most 3 times an hour; then the black
moments.why: everything the night held back, at once, once: the fire burns again for 30 seconds and leaves ash

moments.title: The roof, once an hour
moments.units: 8 UP-HK1915 up into the nave roof structure, full ash white, 8 bars; 4 BSW250 up into the side spans' roofs beside the audience (60 %); the arch: 4 B380F at the column rows behind the floor crossing high over it (ash)
moments.when: once an hour (01:00, 02:00, 03:00, 04:00), out of the black, then gone
moments.why: the bones of the roof appear for 15 seconds: the cathedral the factory was, then darkness again

concept.sentence: MOXIR is ash: the factory burned, we light what is left, and once a night the fire comes back.
rules: Black is the main colour. Two layers at most; three only when the fire returns.
Two colours: ash white and ember red. Nothing else, ever.
Light comes from behind and from the depth, never at the crowd (the 4 blinders, 1-2 s, at the fire's return, are the one exception).
Lines, not washes: one line, a silhouette, a column. Nothing moves unless the music moves it; fades are slow, cuts only on the drop.
Hold back: the roof once an hour, the fire at most 3 times an hour, the blinders only in act 3.
concept.remember: A black figure in front of a dark wall, and twelve lines of light coming out of 60 m of ruin to meet behind him.
concept.direction: from the far gate toward the crowd (back light, depth); the only front light is the blinders' hit
concept.speed: slow: 10-60 s fades; the columns of fire fan over 16 bars; the machines breathe at 0.1 Hz; strobes <= 4 Hz and only at the peak

network.subnet: 192.168.1.0/24, mask 255.255.255.0, no gateway, no DHCP: every address fixed by hand on the unit, written on a label on it
rules: a closed show network: nothing else plugged in, no Wi-Fi bridge (each cube's Wi-Fi OFF, set in LaserOS)
the cubes on ONE switch, SW-LASER, as asked; the desk reaches them through the two backbone links
Art-Net 4: the desk sends unicast to the nodes and the cubes (no broadcast storm on the cubes' 100 Mbit ports)
the cubes' DMX/Art-Net profile is the maker's default 16-ch (ULTRA MK2 Guide pp. 57-59): check on the test whether LaserOS counts the universe from 0 or 1

laser_safety_6w.basis: IEC 60825-1:2014 Table A.1 (0.25 s aversion, 400-700 nm), 4 mm aperture, 1 mrad; the diffuse figure by the ANSI Z136.1 extended-source formula with rho = the press albedo 0.0407 (hall.json, matte dark; NOT measured). ONE beam carries the whole cube power of 6 W, as the scan-failure case always did, so the NOHD does not change with 1 or 2 beams drawn

spotter.method: each beam sampled every 1 m; a sample is seen if the sight line from the eye reaches it with nothing in between (occlusion_lib.Obstacles over hall v9-show-park + the rig boxes); "whole" = the share of samples seen
